cover: A customer asked for SOC 2: what to check

slides.title: Ask the buyer
slides.body: Which report type do you need, Type 1 or Type 2? Which scope? By what date?

slides.title: Check the timeline
slides.body: A Type 2 window only opens once controls are running, then lasts months. Know that before you promise a date.

slides.title: Decide the scope
slides.body: Which systems, which criteria and which report type. Everything inside the scope gets documented and tested.

slides.title: Rank the gaps by time to fix
slides.body: Compare how you work today with the criteria. The slowest gap to close sets your timeline.

slides.title: Check policies match reality
slides.body: The auditor tests whether you do what your policies say. A policy you don't follow becomes a finding.

slides.title: Agree who does what
slides.body: A CPA firm issues the report. If you bring in readiness help, ask what your own team still has to do.
